captions.detailed: This 3D model is a compact, upright coin-cell battery holder designed with a flat bottom and a semi-circular arched top. The front face features a small central hole designed for wire access, while the curved top edge contains a corresponding vertical wire channel hole. The design features a recessed slot on the side to slide the battery in, keeping it partially enclosed and secure.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric coin cell battery holder in OpenSCAD that can be customized for different battery sizes (like CR2032 or CR1225). The script should include parameters for battery diameter, height, number of stacked cells, wall thickness, tolerance, wire hole diameter, and an extra length parameter to extend the opening and partially recess the battery.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by combining two main shapes using a union operation: a main cylinder representing the curved body and a translated cube representing the square extension. A difference operation subtracts a smaller cylinder for the internal battery cavity, a large cube to open up one side, a central longitudinal cylinder for the wire path, and a perpendicular cylinder for a battery push-out hole. The entire assembly is rotated 90 degrees around the Y-axis and translated to sit flat on the print bed.
